title: provenance-post's not-published warning wording depends on whether the publish job succeeded
description: LCLI-628 reviewer finding F4 (#357, 2026-09-28), deferred because it needs a release.yml edit. When the publish job is green, a not-published outcome can only be read-API lag (LCLI-460), after the read-back step already timed out with its own warning (release.yml:1378). But the warning still leads with 'The likely cause is a PARTIAL PUBLISH' and prescribes 'Re-run failed jobs'. Fix: pass needs.publish.result into --post and choose the lead cause from it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: provenance-post's not-published warning leads with read-API lag (LCLI-460) when the publish job succeeded, and with a partial publish only when it did not, by passing needs.publish.result into release-provenance.mjs --post
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; reviewer pass on the scripts/ and release.yml change
